outline:
學生需於第三學年第二學期開始修習「英文實務專題」，於第四學年第一學期期末正式發表成果。本課程旨在發展學生獨立規劃及從事研究的能力，學生可在指導老師的指導下，依個別的需求選擇研究的方向，訂定題目，並獨立完成研究計畫，撰寫報告。 專題研究範圍含： 實驗研究 量調查研究或質調查研究 個案研究 回溯研究 文化比較研究 理論闡述研究
This course is designed to develop the student's background for planning and conducting research independently. The nature of the project conducted will vary from student to student, but regardless of the genre of the project, it must result in a written research report. The research project must be conducted by the student individually. It is anticipated that the project will result from: an experiment; a descriptive study using quantitative procedures or qualitative procedures; a case study; a historical study; a cross-cultural study; a theory that offers an alternative interpretation to a current theory or model.
schedule:
Students turn in three drafts over the course of the semester and do peer reviews of one another's drafts.

Students are evaluated based on
1) their ability to meet research and writing deadlines punctually
2) the growth they show when working on their project (e.g. each draft shows their growth as a researcher and writer
3) their effort (they are clearly putting the necessary work in for their own projects; they also put effort into reviewing / supporting their peers).
4) the quality of the last draft they turn in for the semester (and clear indications of effort on all the previous drafts).
5) Their final presentation (which is weighted 30% in the fall)

Students are already quite aware of my AI policies when it comes to research and writing. I strongly recommend that AI be limited to tools available in library databases--when useful--and possibly to asking for help when proofreading drafts (making the changes manually rather than accepting an AI-updated draft). I do not advice asking AI to make language sound "more scholarly," which is usually unwise, and students should not be doing any brainstorming or interpretation with AI that outsources their thinking. Any AI usage requires permission (via the honor code sheet) and citation.

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
flexible_learning.content: This course does not quite fit the schedule for flexible learning because the students' final papers are always due earlier in the semester than weeks 17 and 18 (and were before we went to the 16+2), though presentations were then in week 17. If students like, they can make arrangements to discuss feedback on their final paper during the +2 period.
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio:
The overall score is
70% Effort and Final Written Product
30% Final Presentation

There is no grade associated with the +2 section of the course.
